children: A fire that broke out at a textile factory in the Chinese city of Foshan in southern Guangdong province on Sunday has killed eight people and injured one, state news agency Xinhua said on Monday.
Search-and-rescue operations are still underway, Xinhua said, without providing details on the cause of the fire.
